definition: to prepare the first meal of the day
translation: làm bữa sáng, nấu bữa sáng
exampleSentence: My dad makes breakfast on weekends.
exampleTranslation: Cuối tuần bố tôi làm bữa sáng.

definition: to heat slices of bread until they are brown
exampleSentence: I make toast and eggs for breakfast.
exampleTranslation: Tôi nướng bánh mì và làm trứng cho bữa sáng.

definition: to put food between two slices of bread
exampleSentence: She makes a sandwich for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy làm một chiếc bánh mì kẹp cho bữa trưa.

definition: to prepare tea in a cup
exampleSentence: Let me make a cup of tea.
exampleTranslation: Để tôi pha một tách trà nhé.

definition: to prepare coffee to drink
exampleSentence: I make coffee every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng pha cà phê.

definition: to let juice flow from a bottle into a glass
exampleSentence: He poured a glass of juice for his sister.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy rót cho em gái một ly nước ép.

definition: to let milk flow from a bottle or box into a cup or bowl
exampleSentence: I pour milk on my cereal.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rót sữa vào bát ngũ cốc.

definition: to put breakfast cereal into a bowl
exampleSentence: The kids pour cereal into their bowls.
exampleTranslation: Bọn trẻ đổ ngũ cốc ra bát.

definition: to cook an egg in hot water
exampleSentence: It takes ten minutes to boil an egg.
exampleTranslation: Luộc một quả trứng mất mười phút.

definition: to spread butter on bread
exampleSentence: I butter the bread and add some cheese.
exampleTranslation: Tôi phết bơ lên bánh mì rồi thêm ít phô mai.

definition: to put jam on bread in a thin layer
exampleSentence: She spreads jam on her toast.
exampleTranslation: Cô ấy phết mứt lên bánh mì nướng.

definition: to put plates, forks and knives on the table; British English
exampleSentence: I lay the table while Mum cooks.
exampleTranslation: Tôi dọn bàn ăn trong lúc mẹ nấu.

definition: to clean the table with a cloth
exampleSentence: Wipe the table with a damp cloth.
exampleTranslation: Hãy lau bàn bằng khăn ẩm.

definition: to give the salt to someone at the table
exampleSentence: Could you pass the salt, please?
exampleTranslation: Bạn chuyền giúp tôi lọ muối được không?

definition: to eat all the food on your plate
exampleSentence: Eat up your vegetables.
exampleTranslation: Ăn hết rau của con đi.

definition: to eat all of your food
exampleSentence: Finish your meal before you watch TV.
exampleTranslation: Ăn xong bữa rồi mới được xem tivi.

definition: to take a second helping of food
exampleSentence: He had seconds because the soup was so good.
exampleTranslation: Bạn ấy ăn thêm một bát vì món súp rất ngon.

definition: to remove water from the plates and glasses with a cloth
exampleSentence: I wash and my brother dries the dishes.
exampleTranslation: Tôi rửa còn em trai lau khô bát đĩa.

definition: to put clean plates and glasses back in the cupboard
exampleSentence: Please put away the dishes when they are dry.
exampleTranslation: Hãy cất bát đĩa khi chúng đã khô.

definition: to put food in a bag or box to eat later
exampleSentence: I pack a lunch for my son every morning.
exampleTranslation: Sáng nào tôi cũng chuẩn bị cơm trưa cho con trai.

definition: to make food from an earlier meal hot again
exampleSentence: We heat up leftovers for lunch.
exampleTranslation: Chúng tôi hâm nóng đồ ăn thừa cho bữa trưa.

definition: to ask a restaurant to prepare food that you take home
exampleSentence: I'm too tired to cook. Let's order takeaway.
exampleTranslation: Tôi mệt quá không nấu nổi. Mình gọi đồ ăn mang về đi.

definition: to not eat breakfast
exampleSentence: I sometimes skip breakfast when I am late.
exampleTranslation: Đôi khi tôi bỏ bữa sáng khi bị trễ giờ.

definition: to have a meal at home
exampleSentence: We usually eat in during the week.
exampleTranslation: Trong tuần chúng tôi thường ăn ở nhà.
